plan: This is a single-round auction, so I need to maximize my expected profit in this round. I should bid lower than my value to ensure a profit if I win. A simple strategy is to bid a fraction of my value. Let's start with 0.8 times my value. My value is $9, so my bid will be $7.2. I will bid $7.2.

This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with 2 other bidders. My value is $9. A common strategy is to bid slightly below your value. I'll start with a bid of $8.50. This allows me to win if the other bids are lower while still securing a profit. If I bid higher, I risk overpaying. If I bid lower, I risk losing the auction. Given this is the only round, I'll stick with this strategy.

I will use a shading strategy. I will bid below my value to increase my profit margin if I win. I will bid 80% of my value, which is $34 * 0.8 = $27.2. This should give me a good chance of winning while also ensuring a decent profit.
